verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is itself an AI assistant that works over your data. It can read the workspace and memory files, turn Discord voice sessions into transcripts and meeting notes, and render charts and tables in Slack. But the evidence never describes a dedicated feature that proactively surfaces insights or suggestions from user data; the capability is mostly implied by the general assistant chat. missing for 10: an explicit documented insights/suggestions feature over user data, detail on how meeting notes or charts are generated from data, independent hands-on corroboration of data-driven insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant for messaging, browser, desktop, and automation workflows.
Discord voice transcripts and meeting notes
OpenClaw remembers things by writing plain Markdown files in your agent's workspace
